# dynamodb

DynamoDB access patterns - Query over Scan, key conditions, bounded reads - plus table posture (PITR, deletion protection) from dumps.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model dynamodb --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model dynamodb-access --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show dynamodb`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-DATA-009, AF-DATA-010, AF-STORE-001, AF-STORE-002
